description: Mixed CSE GPO authored via GPMC Editor — one GPO with three CSE extensions: User-scope Drive (replace with Unicode label), Machine-scope Group (update Administrators), Machine-scope TaskV2 (create with daily trigger)
classification_note: Authored through gpme.msc on Windows Server 2025 and captured via Backup-GPO. Tests multi-CSE GPO with all three adapters exercised from a single backup.

origin.method: Backup-GPO on Windows Server 2025 build 26100, PowerShell 5.1
